tei:div.tei:p: rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rus sbal zhabs dang dra ba 'dzin/ /nag po gu hya rnam rgyal zhabs/ /te lo nā ro pham mthing la/ /gsol ba= sher brtsegs blo gros grags pa'i dpal/ /kun snying bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan sa paṇa la/ /gsol ba= bo dong khro bu yang rtse ba/ /bu ston yab sras tsong kha pa/ /mkhas grub zha lu chen po la/ /gsol ba= kun mkhyen ngag dbang brtson 'grus sogs/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /smon lam ni/ thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ /rnam dag dbang gi sgor zhugs nas/ /dam tshig sdom pa mig 'bras ltar/ /tshul bzhin srung bar nyid gyur cig /ma dag skye shi bar do gsum/ /sbyong byed rim pa dang po'i lam/ /sgrub pa snying por byed pa yis/ /rang rgyud smin par byed nus shog /rjes gzhig rim pa'i rnal 'byor sogs/ /thabs mkhas mchog las bde stong gi /ye shes sgyu lus zung 'jug bcas/ /mngon gyur grol bar byed nus shog /de yi mthu las 'gro ba kun/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /go 'phang mchog la skad cig gis/ /bde blag nyid du 'god nus shog /zhes dang*/ bkra shis ni/ rab yangs nam mkhar 'khor lo bde mchog gi /lha tshogs kha cig me tog char 'bebs shing*/ /la las glu dbyangs gzhan dag bgegs 'joms kyis/ /'phrin las mdzad pas khyed la dpal ster bar/ /shis kyis shis brjod bdag gis bsgrags par bya/ /yan lag bdun ldan khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsang bdag sa ra ha dang klu sgrub zhabs/ /rdo rje dril bu la sogs bla ma la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mchis pa des/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi bkra shis dpal thob shog /bcom ldan he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*/

/mkha' 'gro lā ma dung skyes gzugs can ma/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs thams cad la/ /dge legs mtshan ma= mi mthun phyogs zhi= 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud rnams dang*/ /rim gnyis lam dang de yi phyogs gcig tsam/ / 'dzin par byed dang sgrub pa ma lus la/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mchis pa des/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi bkra shis dpal thob shog /ye shes rang bzhin las grub pho brang mchog /nyi zla 'od 'phro rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'du ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ /dge legs mtshan ma ji snyed mchis pa des/ /mi mthun phyogs zhi bkra shis dpal thob shog /ces dril bu lha lnga'i bla brgyud smon lam shis brjod mdor bsdus 'di yang*/ gnas brtan kun dga' nor bus bskul ba ltar/ bshad sgrub ming can gyis myur bar bris so/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bla brgyud bzhugs/ PAGE 306-PAGE 85--PAGE 84-
